institution.name: LMU Munich, Chair of AI-Assisted Therapy Decisions

field: Machine learning for intensive care medicine
qualifications: Excellent Master's degree or equivalent in computer science, artificial intelligence or a closely related field
Strong background in machine learning and deep learning, Python and PyTorch
Desirable: longitudinal data, NLP, transformers or clinical data analysis
Apply with a single English PDF (CV, transcripts, reference letters, motivation letter) by e-mail to the contact named in the posting
description_short: Three-year PhD position at LMU Munich's Chair of AI-Assisted Therapy Decisions (MCML PI Björn Eskofier) in AIM-ICU, a BMFTR-funded project on ICU monitoring and treatment insights. Starts as soon as possible; applications close 30 November 2026.
